figure_description: A large square divided into a 2 by 2 grid of 4 smaller squares by solid lines. Each of the 4 smaller squares contains two dotted diagonal lines connecting opposite corners, dividing each square into 4 congruent right isosceles triangles, for a total of 16 small triangles.
